name: Sweet Chaos!
source:
you’re a corporate employee at the well-esteemed company “vetacore incorporation”, that has been invited by their fellow colleagues to a server after their first official day!

after getting to know everyone in the server well, you discover that they aren't as innocent as they seem. unravel their secrets and potentially fall in love.

.. hang on? fall in love?

what are you doing? you only joined this company for money!!

[From [url=https://kerocipher.itch.io/sweet-chaos]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是备受尊敬的公司“vetacore incorporation”的一名公司员工，该公司在正式上班的第一天后就被同事邀请到服务器！

当你深入了解服务器中的每个人后，你会发现他们并不像看上去那么无辜。揭开他们的秘密并可能坠入爱河。

.. 不挂断？爱上？

你在干什么？你加入这家公司只是为了钱！！

[来自[url=https://kerocipher.itch.io/sweet-chaos]itch.io[/url]]
